text: ポケモンに　のって　みずの　うえを　すすめる！

structure.jp: ポケモンに　のって
みずの　うえを　すすめる！
structure.en: you can travel across the water!

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing すすむ to すすめる turns 'move forward' into 'can move forward'. すすめる = 'you can move along'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins this action to the next one, here showing the way the next action is done. のって = 'riding on it, and so'.
